svg.aria-label: Four backends behind one call: PNG gets an ai-provenance text chunk spliced in before IEND, switching to compressed zTXt past about 2 KB, with the image never decoded and every other chunk copied byte for byte; JPEG gets a private APP1 segment tagged AIPROV1 spliced straight into the marker structure so the image is never re-encoded; MP4, M4V, M4A and MOV get a uuid box appended after the media data, because the chunk offsets in moov are absolute and anything inserted earlier would leave a file that parses but does not decode; everything else gets a sidecar JSON file. Extraction always falls back to the sidecar.
svg.text: four backends, one record

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the file type picks the mechanism - and none of the mechanisms touches a pixel
embed(record)
.png

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: native
an ai-provenance chunk spliced in before IEND:
tEXt, or zTXt once the record passes about 2 KB
never decoded - IDAT and every other chunk
copied byte for byte, other text chunks kept
.jpg / .jpeg

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: native
a private APP1 segment tagged AIPROV1\0 - distinct
from EXIF's Exif\0\0 and from XMP's URI tag
spliced into the marker structure, never decoded:
JPEG re-encoding is lossy, so it edits bytes only
.mp4 .m4v .m4a .mov

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: native
a uuid box - the format's own private-data slot, the
same one XMP uses - appended AFTER the media data
stco/co64 hold absolute offsets into mdat: insert
earlier and it parses, reports fine, and never decodes
anything else

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sidecar
a <file>.provenance.json written next to the asset
WebM is EBML, not ISO base media - it shares nothing
with the MP4 backend and lands here

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: extract() checks the sidecar as a fallback even for a native format - a sidecar can legitimately outlive an

svg.text: embedded record that some other tool stripped along the way.
